column1: # R-149BMR and 1V110 were fetched and dropped: the first is another turretless
# BTR-80, indistinguishable in a photograph from the R-149MA1, and the second
# is a GAZ-66 with a box body, indistinguishable from the R-142N. Two items a
# learner cannot tell apart make the photo-ID drill unwinnable, since its
# distractors are drawn from the same block.
